candidates.title: Two tabs, service away: one tab's queued reading is erased from the browser and never sent
candidates.area: client store: the Durable tier's pending-writes queue (src/lib/durable.ts, src/store.ts)
candidates.statement: With two tabs open on one project while the service does not answer, each tab saves its own queue over the browser's single IndexedDB snapshot, so a reading recorded in tab A is erased when tab B saves, and after tab A reloads that reading never reaches the service.
candidates.contract: docs/decisions/ADR-014-durable-write-queue.md:20-22 "a write the service has not yet acknowledged is, so a decision made while the service is away survives a reload and is sent when the service answers"; src/lib/projectState.ts:10-12 "an outbox, saved with the preferences (durable.ts), so a deposition at the bench survives a reload while the service is away and is sent when it answers again"
candidates.expected: Tab A's reading (5.5 USD/kg) stays in the browser's queue through tab B's save and tab A's reload, and the service holds it once it answers.
candidates.observed: The IndexedDB outbox held tab A's deposition after A wrote, held only tab B's after B wrote, and held only B's after A reloaded; once /api answered and the page reloaded, the service held A's deposition with 0 entries and B's with 6.6 USD/kg. Neither page said a reading was dropped.
candidates.cause: src/lib/durable.ts:50 (one key, 'snapshot', for the whole browser) with src/store.ts:3669 saveDurable(snapshotOf(s)), which writes this tab's stateOutbox whole (src/store.ts:3539) and reads nothing another tab stored
candidates.evidence: scripts/outbox.mjs twotabs on a copy of openferment_dev seeded with a locked runbook (port 8872), then again from a fresh copy through repro.sh (port 8873): the same sequence both times.

candidates.title: After a reload while the service is away, the bench says the deposition is not found, and the queue waits for a second reload
candidates.area: client store hydration and the Deposition bench (src/store.ts, src/screens/Deposition.tsx)
candidates.statement: A reload while the service does not answer leaves the project's rows unloaded, so the bench says the project holds no such deposition while its readings sit in the browser's queue, and once the service answers again nothing is sent until the page is reloaded a second time; during the outage the bench never says its readings wait for the service.
candidates.contract: docs/decisions/ADR-014-durable-write-queue.md:20-22 "so a decision made while the service is away survives a reload and is sent when the service answers"; src/screens/Deposition.tsx:1086-1088 "The deposition is the record, kept on the service as it changes, so the bench resumes after a reload"
candidates.expected: After the reload the bench shows the deposition with its queued readings laid over it and says they wait for the service; when the service answers, the queue is sent.
candidates.observed: After the reload with /api refused: data-state=missing, "Deposition not found This project holds no deposition dep-mwb7zows-1, or its rows have not loaded from the service yet", while the IndexedDB outbox still held that deposition with 1 entry and 1 observation; its runbook's page said "Runbook not found ... the link may be from another project". With /api answering for 40 s and no reload the service held 0 entries; within 30 s of a second reload it held 4.4 USD/kg and the observation. In the stop scenario the bench read "3 measured · 1 observed" with the service stopped and no word that the three writes were waiting.
candidates.cause: src/store.ts:1043-1051 hydrateProjectState sets stateProblem and returns when GET /api/state fails, and nothing calls it again; the queue is laid over held rows only after a successful load (src/store.ts:1073); src/store.ts:3634 skips every change while stateSeen is null, so flushProjectState is not called again before the next page load
candidates.evidence: scripts/outbox.mjs reload and stop on port 8872; the outbox read from IndexedDB in the page at each step; the service's rows read from GET /api/state.

candidates.title: Two tabs on one deposition: the second tab's reading is refused, dropped, and still listed as recorded
candidates.area: client store: rows sent whole from a stale view (src/lib/projectState.ts, src/store.ts, src/components/DepositionPanel.tsx)
candidates.statement: When two tabs hold one running deposition, a reading recorded in the tab whose view is older is sent as the whole row as that tab holds it, the service refuses it for leaving out the other tab's reading, the queue drops it, and that tab's bench goes on listing the reading as recorded until a reload removes it.
candidates.contract: src/screens/Deposition.tsx:1086-1087 "The deposition is the record, kept on the service as it changes"; docs/decisions/ADR-014-durable-write-queue.md:20-22 (a write survives until the service answers)
candidates.expected: Tab B's 8.8 USD/kg is kept beside tab A's 7.7 USD/kg (the row read again and the entry appended), or tab B's bench takes the reading back and says it was not kept.
candidates.observed: Both PUT /api/state/depositions/<id> writes from tab B answered 422 "dep-... keeps every reading it was given, and this write leaves out de-...-2; a reading is corrected by a new one", shown as two toasts; the service held 7.7 USD/kg alone; tab B's measures list kept "8.8 USD/kg"; after a reload tab B showed 1 measured, tab A's.
candidates.cause: src/lib/projectState.ts:96-104 changes() sends each row as this page holds it; src/lib/projectState.ts:180-183 drops a refused row from the queue and leaves the page's copy as it was; no page reads again a row another tab changed
candidates.evidence: scripts/outbox.mjs sameonline on port 8872, run three times; tab B's PUT answers and toasts captured.

candidates.title: Two tabs on one scenario's parameter panel: one person's override erases the other's, with no word

candidates.expected: The service keeps feed_glucose_conc=1.234 (tab A) and titre=5.678 (tab B).

candidates.cause: src/lib/projectState.ts:78 (overrides keyed by scope, the row's value the scope's whole list) with src/store.ts:2393-2400 setOverride writing the list from this tab's view
candidates.evidence: scripts/overrides_twotabs.mjs on port 8872: a scenario made on ethanol_glucose_v0 through New scenario, both tabs on its panel, each value typed in a row's value box; the service's overrides read from GET /api/state.

candidates.title: An address naming a project the service does not hold reloads the page without end
candidates.area: client routing and project opening (src/App.tsx, src/store.ts)
candidates.statement: Opening /#/p/<id>/... for an id the service holds no project under makes the page reload about 19 times a second, each load asking GET /api/projects, and it never settles on a screen.
candidates.contract: docs/decisions/ADR-009-ui.md:21-22 "an address naming another project opens it (the page reloads in it, as a project switch does)"
candidates.expected: One reload at most, then a screen that says the service holds no project of that id and lists the projects it holds.
candidates.observed: 285 and 274 page loads, with as many GET /api/projects, in 15 s on two runs; localStorage openferment.project left as 'nosuchproject'.
candidates.cause: src/App.tsx:141 opens route.project whenever it differs from the store's projectId; src/store.ts:1017 loadProjects replaces an open id the list lacks with the only project held (or null), so the two differ on every load and openProject reloads again (src/store.ts:1023-1027)
candidates.evidence: scripts/unknown_project.mjs against the full project's service (8871) and from a fresh copy through repro.sh (8873), counting load events and /api/projects requests.

candidates.title: With the service stopped, five detail pages say the project holds no such row
candidates.area: client screens' service-down words (RunbookDetail, DepositionDetail, PaperReader, GuildSkills, Postdoc)
candidates.statement: When the service does not answer, the runbook, deposition, paper, Guild skill and Postdoc conversation pages say the project keeps no such row, while the protocol, strain, lesson, run, comparison and flowsheet pages say the service is not running.
candidates.contract: src/lib/http.ts:3-4 "`ServiceDown`: nothing answered ... the remedy names the command that starts the service"; the strain page answers the same state with "The project's strain catalogue could not be read: The service is not running"
candidates.expected: Each page says the service is not running and how to start it.
candidates.observed: Refused: /runbooks/<id> "The project keeps no runbook of that id; the link may be from another project"; /runbooks/depositions/<id> "This project holds no deposition with this id"; /biorepo/paper/<id> "<id> is not a document this project holds"; /guild/skills/<id> "The project's skill catalogue holds no skill h7-skill"; /postdoc/<id> "No conversation yet: a person asks the first question". Each of these opens the row with the service up.
candidates.cause: src/screens/RunbookDetail.tsx:596, src/screens/DepositionDetail.tsx:255, src/screens/PaperReader.tsx:260, src/screens/GuildSkills.tsx:88, src/screens/Postdoc.tsx:397 draw the empty state from the store's lists without reading stateProblem, cataloguesProblem or the failed call
candidates.evidence: scripts/stopped_words.mjs: 18 pages read with the service up and again with every /api request refused, the main region's text compared.

candidates.contract: docs/decisions/ADR-009-ui.md:21 "a navigation or a link from inside a project stays inside it (`inProject`)"
candidates.expected: The logo opens #/p/<project> (or keeps the prefix), and the links after it keep /p/<project>/.
candidates.observed: From #/p/ethanol/runbooks the logo opened #/ (Home, "Bioprocess literature you can operate on"), the top bar still named Ethanol, the rail links read #/ #/intake #/biorepo ..., and following Intake gave #/intake. On the 74 walked addresses in three states this was the one in-app anchor leaving the project. Home's activity links are written from raw '#/...' strings (src/screens/Home.tsx:932-935).
candidates.cause: src/App.tsx:498 <a href="#/"> written by hand, where every other rail link uses href()
candidates.evidence: scripts/logo.mjs on the full project (8871); scripts/walk_all.mjs collected every anchor's href on every page.
